issues.description: The template repository contains conflicting fixed-point size definitions: the test harness (tests/src/math_fix.h) defines FIX_LEN as 4 (32-bit fix_t) while the example program (example_program/src/math_fix.c and code that depends on FIX_LEN) uses FIX_LEN = 8 (64-bit fix_t). This discrepancy means the test build and the example program expect different underlying sizes for fix_t and related typedefs, which can cause confusing behaviour, incorrect test expectations, and linking/type mismatches for students. The solution repository shows tests using FIX_LEN = 8 (consistent with the example program), indicating the template's tests header is likely an unintentional inconsistency.
issues.suggestedFix: Make FIX_LEN consistent across the template repository: update tests/src/math_fix.h to define FIX_LEN = 8 (matching example_program/src/math_fix.c and the solution), or alternatively change the example program to use FIX_LEN = 4 if 32-bit is intended. Ensure all files that typedef fix_t (tests, example_program, and any headers) share the same FIX_LEN so students are not blocked by inconsistent fixed-point type sizes.
